cases.title: New learner opening on a busy comp

rubric.reason: The opening proposes a concrete start without being asked: "I suggest we start with **Title**. It has 4 pairs to ease…"
It proposes only Title and names its 4 pairs; Subtitle's Opacity is the only other pair named (5 total), and the rest are given as counts ("11 keyframe pairs… spread over 6 layers").
It names both left-out layers with reasons, "Old Take is hidden" and "Icon is a precomp. I can't see inside it yet, so I'm not saying it's fine", matching hidden_layers and precomp_layers.

All names and times match snapshot_project: 11 pairs = 10 linear + 1 partly_eased; 6 layers are Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take; Subtitle Opacity has linear_end "end" ("stops hard at the end"); Title's Position is 0.5→1.5→3 s and its Scale and Opacity are 0.5–1.5 s.
It called read_learner_record before snapshot_project, the record had empty skills and lessons (a new learner), and the opening claims no history.

The opening is the count, the proposal and the leave-outs as one choice, with no explanation of easing, and it ends on a single question about the layer: "Shall we start with Title, or would you rather pick another layer?"

It names both left-out layers with reasons, "Old Take: you've hidden it" and "Icon: it's a precomp, and I can't see inside those yet, so I'm not saying it's fine", matching hidden_layers and precomp_layers.

All names and times match snapshot_project: 11 = 10 linear + 1 partly_eased, the 6 layers are Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take, Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s plus Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s are correct, and Subtitle Opacity has linear_end "end", which backs "stops hard at the end".
No learner record is set (read_learner_record returned empty skills and lessons), and the opening claims no earlier history.

The opening holds the count, the proposal and the leave-outs as one choice, includes no easing explanation, and ends on a single question about the layer: "Shall we start with Title, or is there another layer you'd rather work on?"
Without being asked, the opening reports what it found ("11 keyframe pairs that need easing, across 6 layers") and proposes a starting layer: "I'd start with **Title**."
It proposes only Title and names its four pairs; the only other pair named is Subtitle's Opacity in the summary, so five pairs in total, which is within the limit.

It names the hidden layer ("Old Take: you've hidden it, so I'll skip it") and the precomp, and says why without implying the precomp is fine ("Icon: it's a precomp, and I can't see inside those yet, so I'm not saying it's fine").

Every name and time matches snapshot_project: 11 pairs is 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased, the 6 layers are Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take, Subtitle's Opacity 0.3–1.3 s has linear_end "end", Title's pairs and times match, and Logo's single_key Scale and expression-driven Rotation match the skipped list.
This is a new learner with an empty record (read_learner_record returned no skills or lessons), and the opening claims no earlier history.
